new_findings: Community Shaders live-postprocessing bridge calls PrepareCSUpscaleInput and CaptureCSDepthAndMotion(true).
CS capture converges into prepared depth +0xB50 and motion +0xBA8 and can shader-transform inputs.
Generic D3D11 resource detection remains as a fallback/sibling path.
Both SR and FG consume the same prepared depth/motion pair.
Normal SR producer explicitly zeros common payload +0x20, proven reactive by both FSR consumers.
DX11 FSR path supplies null external exposure and null transparency/composition while context flags include auto exposure.
DX11 context base flags do not contain dynamic-resolution bit 6 on the inspected creation path.
Several additional SR-reset writers remain semantically unattributed; menu event code is not mislabeled as a reset writer.
